messages:
alice: FYI saw a 250ms tail-latency bump on a sustained long-context workload this morning. starts ~10:12 UTC and spikes every 30s for ~3m.
ben_m: ugh. did kernel selection change? any recent deploys? :eyes:
alice: no kernel churn. model variant pinned. batching profile steady. flamegraph shows a big spike in kv pager time. attaching quick dump.
carla-r: can you paste the pprof snippet or top functions?
alice: top:
```
# pprof top
60.2% runtime/pager
12.5% evicter.loop
8.1% kv.reinsert
6.0% gc/alloc
```
ben_m: evicter.loop and kv.reinsert together sounds like eviction-reinsert thrash. under pressure FIFO can reinsert same entry -> churn. did we hit reuse window regression?
dmitri: I saw a repro in CI where FIFO + delayed tombstone cleanup caused the item to be treated as cold and reinserted repeatedly when many long-contexts hit same shard. triggered under ~80% mem pressure.
alice: repro command I used: `LOAD_AVG=0.9 ./run_longctx_stress --seq 8192 --clients 120 --duration 5m` results attached.
carla-r: dropping a small snippet of the eviction logic we used:
```
// simplified
if (fifo.front()->expired()) {
  pop_front();
  push_back(entry);
}
```
carla-r: missing an update to the reuse timestamp when reinserting can make LRU heuristics think it's cold. that plus paging wins -> immediate eviction again.
ben_m: So correctness bug: reinserts should refresh 'last_used' before being eligible for eviction. Otherwise we get a reinsert-evict loop.
alice: i can confirm that adding `entry->touch(now)` before push_back eliminates the loop in repro and drops pager CPU by ~6x. will open PR.
dmitri: nice. any latency regressions that explain 250ms?
alice: yes — when the evicter spins and reclaims repeatedly, it blocks the pager's allocator lock and causes token fetches to stall for dozens of ms. it accumulates to that 250ms.
ben_m: mitigation options: (1) refresh reuse timestamp on reinserts (cheap), (2) add a short probation window after reinsert to avoid immediate eviction, (3) bounded reinserts per-entry per-interval.
carla-r: also consider sequence-length-aware policies: long-context flows should bias towards LRU to favor reuse; short bursts can use FIFO for locality.
alice: opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/evicter/merge_requests/1245 - PR description + microbench. includes regression test that reproduces the loop.
dmitri: can we hotfix to dedicated clusters ASAP? schedule deploy? :rocket:
evicter-bot: deploy-bot: staged rollout started for rev evicter/1245 on cluster-kv-pool-3 (canary 10%).
ben_m: after canary verify, push to rest-of-cluster. let's also add an observability counter for reinserts-per-entry and pager-lock-hold-ms.
alice: will add metrics + smoke test. tracked in the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
